risk_study.accounting: write-off = an open bag's remaining units are marked at zero, the conservative all-or-nothing reading
risk_study.selection_rule: highest bootstrap CI lower bound of the write-off P&L per ticket, among rules with at least min_trades OOF trades; the paired difference against the incumbent rule on the same tickets is reported as the honest comparison
risk_study.strict_ev_note: strict_ev_per_ticket = hit * alloc * (tp_mult - 1) - (1 - hit) * alloc, i.e. the literal 'reach the target or lose the whole ticket' rule with no partial exit; the engine's own idle/holding-limit sale is NOT credited in that column
